item.title: 【Requests】[REQ CAP] - Florence + The Machine Hurricane and Southside Festivals 2026
item.description: Can some kind soul please capture the upcoming Florence + The Machine appearances at Hurricane Festival (June 20) and Southside Festival (June 21) and share it with us? Her festival appearances this summer could possibly be the last performances we get for a very long time. Thank you, it's greatly appreciated!
